_comment: Shared compliance fixture, read by BOTH pytest (tests/test_guardrails.py) and vitest (web/tests/unit/compliance.test.ts). Two implementations of the same regexes will drift apart unless one fixture judges them both. Add a case here first, then make both sides pass it.

blocked.text: Investors should sell NIFTY Bank before the meeting.
blocked.why: recommendation framing around a trade verb

blocked.text: We recommend accumulating metals on this dip.
Our advice is to exit pharma.
Infosys will fall over the next week.
blocked.why: forward-looking directional claim about a named security

blocked.text: Expect NIFTY IT to drop after this.
The stock is going to rise from here.
Price target of Rs 1,450 on this name.
There is downside of 12% from current levels.
Time to buy the dip in IT.
Go long on the rupee here.
Strong buy rating on this sector.

allowed.text: NIFTY IT's median 5-day abnormal return across 12 past H-1B tightening events was -180 bps.
allowed.why: a measured historical statistic with its sample size

allowed.text: Historically, across 33 past occurrences, the median cumulative abnormal return was +40 bps (p = 0.77).
A weaker rupee raises the rupee value of dollar-denominated revenue.
Low foreign ownership means there is little left to sell in a broad outflow.
allowed.why: the word sell appears, but not as an instruction; a naive blocklist would wrongly flag this

allowed.text: That distribution is not statistically distinguishable from zero, so treat this linkage as weak evidence.
The transmission map records this linkage as two-sided; the mechanism can transmit in either direction.
allowed.why: preserves ambiguity rather than resolving it

allowed.text: Across the sample the realised hit rate was 66%.
NIFTY IT has historically fallen after this archetype was detected.
allowed.why: explicitly historical, so the forecast check must exempt it

allowed.text: The observed median move was negative in 8 of 12 past occurrences.
Impacto presents historical statistics and economic mechanisms for information and education only.
Consult a SEBI-registered investment adviser before making any investment decision.
allowed.why: the required pointer must pass; it contains advice words but is not a recommendation

allowed.text: Where your holdings sit relative to the sectors these archetypes have historically moved.
allowed.why: portfolio copy describes exposure, never action
